title: 공군방공관제사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <Presidential Decree No. 28266, September 5, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) The Decree on the Air Force Air Defense Control Command shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3 (2), "장관급(將官級) 장교로" (the former expression for general-officer grade) shall be replaced with "장성급(將星級) 장교로" (general-officer grade), and "장관급 장교 또는" shall be replaced with "장성급 장교 또는".

(8) through (90) Omitted.
